[SWS_DM_01090] Calling ExecuteReset() if positive response shall be sent after reset
⌈
If the parameter DiagnosticEcuResetClass.respondToReset
is set to respondAfterReset, the Diagnostic Server instance shall directly call
ara::diag::EcuResetRequest::ExecuteReset without sending the positive re-
sponse according to [SWS_DM_00268].
⌋
